title: Stay safe in thunder and lightning — Met Office
claims: When you hear thunder you are already within range where the next ground flash may occur; lightning can strike as far as 10 miles from the centre of a storm.

If outside, avoid water and find a low-lying open place a safe distance from trees, poles or metal objects; avoid golf, rod fishing and boating, and be aware of conducting objects including umbrellas, motorbikes, bicycles, wire fencing and rails; in a tent stay away from the metal poles.
In an exposed location, squat close to the ground with hands on knees and the head tucked in; touch as little of the ground with the body as possible, and do not lie down.
If you feel your hair stand on end, drop to that position immediately.
If caught in a storm in a car, wind up the windows and stay inside; a metal roof and frame acts as a conductive Faraday cage, while soft-top convertibles are the most at risk.
